Name: They Will Stay With You Unofficial English
Author: IkarosHDD
Description:
As Far as I know there used to be a different English translation. However I couldn't find one for the current version, so I ended up doing it myself.

Disclaimer: I do not speak the original language the mod was made it, I simply ran it through a translator. That's why I'm calling my version an "Unofficial" one it's likely there will be some weird translations here and there. However from my brief look at it in game it seems good enough.

My Mod here will be removed if the original author wills it or someone else makes a more accurate/informed take on it. This simply exists so you can use the latest version. (Currently 1.1.2) in English.

That all being said if things are wrong translation wise, it's unlikely I can do anything about it.

Enjoy!

Installation:

1 - Unzip the translation zip into the mod so that "default.json" and "en.json" end up inside the original mods i18n folder.

2 - Deploy your mods

3 - Start Praying or Playing
